# Iltonggi (一統記 · 일통기)

> A Three Kingdoms strategy game for iOS by ipe Studio, in 12 languages. This site has the game page and a making-of blog (one short note a day).

## Pages
- [Home](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/): what the game is
- [Support](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/support/)
- [Privacy](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/privacy/)
- [Terms](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/terms/)

## Blog (every post exists in en, ko, ja, zh, es, pt, id, ru, vi, fr, de; other languages show the English post)
- [Blog index](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/blog/)
- [RSS feed](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/blog/feed.xml)
